decisions.reason: The candidate already captures the same-message conditional 5V supply and GPIO3 switching for the SK6812 LEDs; the boost current and other powered loads do not change its state.
The battery voltage range and AXP2101 destination are independently represented by an existing same-message Event; the boost-output changes do not alter the battery interface.
The standalone LDO operating mode is independently and fully represented by an existing same-message Event; changing the switched 5V boost load mapping does not change it.
The 3.3V source OR-ing behavior is independently represented by an existing same-message Event and is unaffected by the 5V boost current and load list.
The charge-status indication requirement remains unchanged; conditional SK6812 supply behavior belongs to the separate addressable-LED power requirement.
The source decision does not change the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability constraints.
The operating-mode power mapping does not modify the established VMID-to-VSYS topology or net-label requirement.
The source mentions the battery feeding AXP2101 but does not change any overcharge, overdischarge, thermal, or other protection behavior.
The source decision does not change the battery NTC temperature-sensing method or connection.
The power mapping has no effect on the power board's eight-layer stack.
The boost current and powered-load mapping do not change board dimensions, orientation, mounting, connector placement, or enclosure-fit constraints.
The source decision does not change the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
